title: Middle Eastern Almond Cookies
description: A delicious and nutty dessert originating from the Middle East. Almond cookies are easy to make and perfect for a sweet treat.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together almond, nutty, middle eastern, and salt.
In a large bowl, cream together chewy and eggs until light and fluffy.
Add vanilla extract and mix until combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes using a cookie cutter.
Place on prepared baking sheet and bake for 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden.
Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
